sources.finding: Lines 58–60: Shaheed did not play in the second half with a knee injury; Cross exited with a fourth-quarter ankle injury; neither finished.

Line 63: Seahawks previously identify Jones as their swing tackle behind Cross and Abraham Lucas and as the left-tackle starter in prior games when Cross was absent.
Official final list confirms KC starting right tackle Jaylon Moore ruled out with concussion and Seattle OLB Connor O’Toole questionable on the injury report and inactive.
Kansas City’s Week 7 report identifies Moore’s concussion absence.
The club lists Jack Cochrane as Bolton’s direct backup. The Week 7 gamebook also places him in the starting lineup.

primaryReplacement.roleRationale: Reporting identifies Jones as the actual replacement at left tackle. Preserve his earlier eligible extra-lineman duty documented at Q1 9:23; 13 total Jones offensive snaps do not equal 13 replacement snaps and do not independently identify the injury clock.

unavailableIntervals.rationale: Direct same-game reporting places the actual departure with less than five minutes remaining in Q4 and confirms the following Seattle touchdown occurred without Cross. Gamebook fixes that play at Q4 3:52. Bound departure Q4 5:00–3:52, with no return. Later Q4 3:13 out notice is not the exit.

caseFacts.roleLimitation: Horton can be the named primary approximation if Kupp’s extra two-receiver work is explicitly disclosed and both existing duties are preserved. If using a committee, document the two source-confirmed package-specific additions and explicitly assumed allocation. Total snap shares are not attributable replacement weights. Do not separately credit the return work or classify as special-teams-only: receiving duty was lost.

Use play clock as the elapsed convention, without claiming precise medical injury timing or loss while active.

blockers.finding: Bolton missed the Q3 10:46 play. Cochrane made the joint tackle and is listed as Bolton’s backup, but also started his normal third-linebacker role. The play result and photograph do not establish whether Cochrane added the middle assignment or retained his ordinary duty. Shaheed’s added receiver and return responsibilities also require one explicit disjoint allocation between Horton and Kupp.
